title: Diffusion Precipitation Generation with Medium-range Weather Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.12976v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate daily precipitation forecasts are important for weather-sensitive decisions. Although recent Weather Foundation Models (WFMs) have achieved significant progress, they are trained on reanalysis data, which exhibit regional and intensity-dependent biases. Since retraining WFMs on observation-based targets is costly, we study Dynamics-Precipitation Decoupling, a plug-and-play framework that uses a separately trained generator to map non-precipitation forecasts from a frozen weather model to observation-aligned daily precipitation. Its key challenges are to capture heterogeneous rainfall distributions and align daily accumulations with atmospheric signals that evolve across space and time. To address them, we train a diffusion generator conditional on atmospheric states and satellite-gauge estimates of precipitation. A multi-scale recurrent encoder summarizes atmospheric evolution, while cross-attention aligns atmospheric and precip

translated_title: 结合中期天气预报的扩散模型降水生成
translated_abstract: 准确的每日降水预报对于对天气敏感的决策至关重要。尽管近期的天气基础模型已经取得了显著进展，但它们是在再分析数据上训练的，这些数据存在区域性和强度相关的偏差。由于在基于观测的目标上重新训练WFMs成本高昂，我们研究了动力学-降水解耦，这是一个即插即用的框架，利用单独训练的生成器将冻结天气模型的非降水预报映射为与观测对齐的每日降水。其关键挑战在于捕获异构的降雨分布，并将每日累积降水与随空间和时间演变的大气信号对齐。为了解决这些问题，我们训练了一个以大气状态和卫星-雨量计降水估计为条件的扩散生成器。多尺度循环编码器用于总结大气演变过程，而交叉注意力机制则将大气与降水信息对齐。
tldr: 该论文提出“动力学-降水解耦”即插即用框架，利用以大气状态和卫星-雨量计降水估计为条件的扩散生成器，将冻结天气基础模型的预报映射为与观测对齐的每日降水，从而克服再分析数据带来的区域性和强度相关偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Dynamics-Precipitation Decoupling, a plug-and-play framework that uses a diffusion generator conditioned on atmospheric states and satellite-gauge precipitation estimates to map forecasts from a frozen weather foundation model to observation-aligned daily precipitation, overcoming regional and intensity-dependent biases in reanalysis data.
